Priya Desai: Quick sync — Zephyr bring-up tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final sign-off on quota assignment, autoscale cooldowns, and soak strategy. cc @Liam Ho @Jorge Alvarez
Liam Ho: Quick answers — account shows 60k reserved tokens/min. Recommend keeping ~25% headroom (45k steady + 15k burst) for first 72h. That prevents immediate oversubscription.
Jorge Alvarez: I can run tonight's soak + focused burst. Sharing the load plan and a tiny k6 snippet for the burst run. Do we want KV-cache priming included?
Jorge Alvarez: ```
// k6 snippet
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({model: 'rw-dedicated-7b', prompt: 'short test'}), { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer $TEST_TOKEN' } });
}
```
Liam Ho: Include KV priming — without it we see tail latency spikes. Also set throttling policy: SLO p95 <= 200ms, circuit-breaker at 3xx>2% for 1m. Autoscale cooldown: drop to 45s during warmup.
Priya Desai: Quick billing question — will temporary 25% buffer affect customer's committed quota or billing? @Nina (CSM) can confirm customer OK with temporary throttles.
Nina (CSM): Spoke with Zephyr ops — they approved a 25% buffer for first 72 hours. They also asked for daily health digests and a 20-min enablement walkthrough. I'll send the invite and confirm the billing note.
ops-bot: Load test scheduled by Jorge Alvarez: start=2024-03-22T02:00:00Z, runner=k6-3.2, job=bt-9812
Jorge Alvarez: Starting smoke-run now — hitting ~40k sustained while priming. Quick log snippet: "cache-hit-rate 78% -> 92% after priming"
ops-bot: Test finished: peak=62k rps (30s spike), average=47k rps; errors=0.6% (mostly 429 throttles); p95 latency=230ms. Artifacts: https://internal.redwood/incoming/bt-9812
Priya Desai: Thanks — action items: (1) adjust autoscale cooldown to 45s, (2) enable temporary throttle for non-critical routes during burst, (3) daily health digest to Zephyr ops. Assigning @Liam Ho and @Nina (CSM).
Liam Ho: I'll implement cooldown + route-level throttle. Also will update smart-routing to divert a small fraction to a quantized model variant as a graceful fallback.
Nina (CSM): Invite sent for the 20-min walkthrough and daily digest cadence confirmed. I've posted the customer feedback form: https://forms.gle/zephy-feedback
Priya Desai: Perfect — reconvene after 72h for post-mortem and renewal note. :thumbsup:
